title: Do not replace interacting weights by a nearly occupied free mode
statement: Exact product-zero-mode projection costs4K/3 potential energy, while the normalized squeezed trial has sublinear energy and vanishing depleted fraction. Small depletion and known one-particle modes alone do not qualify interacting critical Gibbs weights. Fixed-mode canonical diagonalization and properly paid squeezed corrections remain ordinary alternatives.
